title: The Last Spire Revisited
author: Orsen Hartwell
blurb: Edmund Ravensworth, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the long winter finishes falling.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
